name: Crushridge Warmongers
summary: Marshal Redpath of Southshore wants the Crushridge ogres hit harder than before. You are sent into the Ruins of Alterac to find the Crushridge Warmongers, so the brutes will stay away from the Alliance.

sections.title: A Harder Lesson
sections.body: After Crushridge Bounty, Marshal Redpath wants the ogres to feel it in earnest. Redpath sends you into the Ruins of Alterac to seek out the Crushridge Warmongers and cut down plenty of them. Redpath holds that nothing else will teach the brutes to stay clear of Alliance territory.

faq.q: Who sends you after the Crushridge Warmongers?

faq.answer: In the Ruins of Alterac, up in the mountains.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Redpath want the Warmongers cut down?
faq.answer: Redpath believes nothing else will teach the Crushridge ogres to stay away from Alliance lands.
It follows Crushridge Bounty, Redpath's first call to hunt the Crushridge ogres.
